LandingPage.faq_1_q: How do I start a course?
LandingPage.faq_1_a: Create a student account, choose a Foundation or Specialization program, and enroll. Once enrolled, you can immediately access the learning modules.
LandingPage.faq_2_a: Yes. Every certificate has a unique ID and QR code that links to the official verification page, allowing anyone to verify its authenticity.
LandingPage.faq_3_a: No. The Foundation Level is designed for beginners. You only need a browser and motivation to learn.
LandingPage.faq_4_a: Foundation (CBEc) covers the basics of Blue Economy complete with exams and field study. Specialization offers 10 in-depth tracks, such as Blue Carbon, Blue Finance, and Blue Energy.
LandingPage.faq_5_a: Yes. Submit a motivation letter from the student dashboard; the admin will decide if you receive Fully Funded, Partial, or no scholarship.
LandingPage.courses_title: Choose a program and start today.
LandingPage.courses_desc: Every program includes modules, exams, and a verifiable certificate.
LandingPage.courses_bottom_text: Complete Foundation to unlock Specialization tracks.
LandingPage.why_title: Skills that put you one step ahead.
LandingPage.why_desc: The ocean is a source of sustainable economic growth. We teach the skills needed in the maritime industry, policy, and blue finance — straight to the point.
LandingPage.why_stat_1: SDG 14 as the basis of the Foundation curriculum
LandingPage.why_stat_3: types of assessment: MCQ, essay, field study
LandingPage.cert_sec_desc: Complete a program and a certificate is issued in your name, complete with a unique ID that anyone can check online.
LandingPage.inc_sec_desc: No hidden fees. Apply for a scholarship from the dashboard and program fees can be partially or fully covered.
LandingPage.cta_title: Your new skills are just hours away.

LandingCourseTabs.c_foundation_desc: Basics of the Blue Economy ecosystem: SDG 14, UNCLOS 1982, fisheries governance, and blue finance.
LandingCourseTabs.c_biz_desc: Design sustainable and investment-ready blue business models.
LandingCourseTabs.c_carbon_desc: Mangrove, seagrass, and coastal carbon valuation for climate mitigation.
LandingCourseTabs.c_energy_desc: Ocean energy potential and coastal renewable investment feasibility.
LandingCourseTabs.c_finance_desc: Blue financing instruments, bonds, and ocean investment risk management.
LandingCourseTabs.c_port_desc: Green ports, maritime logistics, and ocean supply chain connectivity.
LandingCourseTabs.c_food_desc: Safe, equitable, and sustainable ocean food systems.
LandingCourseTabs.c_data_desc: Ocean data analytics for policy and business decisions.
LandingCourseTabs.c_comm_desc: Coastal community empowerment and gender equality in the ocean sector.
